query: SELECT atrb.workspace_id AS "workspace_id!", role_permission.permission_id AS "permission_id!", (atrb.scope_id = atrb.workspace_id) AS "is_workspace_scope!", atrb.scope_id AS "scope_id?" FROM api_token_role_binding atrb INNER JOIN role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = atrb.role_id WHERE atrb.token_id = $1;
